summary: Removes the first node whose stored data pointer matches a2 from a singly-linked container (head at this+0x0, tail at this+0x4, count at this+0xC). Unlinks the node, adjusts the current-node cursor this+0x8 when needed, optionally frees the node payload and then the node itself, and returns 1. Returns 0 when the target a2 is null or the list is empty.

operations.description: Return 0 immediately when the removal target a2 is null (no data pointer to match).
Return 0 when the head pointer this[0] is null, meaning the container is empty.

Walk the list from the head using each node's next pointer at obj+0x4, comparing each node's stored data pointer against a2 and remembering the previous node; return 0 when the next pointer becomes null before a match.
When the matched node equals the current-node cursor this[2], advance this[2] to the matched node's next pointer (obj+0x4).
Unlink the matched node: set the previous node's next (obj+0x4) to the matched node's next, or set the container head this[0] to that next when there is no previous node.
When the matched node is the container tail this[1], set the tail to the previous node.
When the keep-node flag a3 is zero, clear the node flag byte at obj+0x8 (marking the node as no longer owning its payload).
When the node flag byte at obj+0x8 is set and the node's data pointer is non-null, call EmptyStub_0170 and free the payload via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Free the node object via FreeWrapper_7bcf and return 1 (success).
